task.title: Trace Keyword Pop-up Resolution Flow Across Maps and Topics
task.shortdesc: Follow the key resolution path from the topic to the root map to identify where the Insert keyword pop-up lookup fails.

step.cmd: In the topic where the Insert keyword pop-up is missing, identify the exact key name being requested by the editor (the keyword/keyref you expect to insert).
Search the root map for that key name and confirm there is exactly one intended definition in scope for this deliverable.
If the key is defined in a submap, confirm that submap is referenced from the root map with a normal <mapref>/<topicref> path (not excluded by conditions).
Review filtering/conditional processing on maprefs and topicrefs (for example, audience/platform/product attributes) to ensure the branch containing the <keydef> is not filtered out.
Check for key shadowing by searching for duplicate @keys values in included submaps; if found, determine which definition should win and remove or rename conflicting keys.
Rebuild or refresh the editor’s key space/index (for example, re-open the root map or trigger a project refresh) and retry Insert keyword.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
